articles.summary: New research on affluent families, averaging $3.7 million in investable assets, reveals sharp differences in how parents and adult children view and prepare for wealth transfer As families prepare to pass wealth to the next generation, new research from Wells Fargo Wealth Investment Management finds that the greatest hurdles are often not financial but personal, centered on the conversations, expectations, and planning decisions that accompany wealth transfer. Wells Fargo red sign displayed on a city building exterior The 2026 Wealth Transfer Study surveyed more than 800 Baby Boomer parents and nearly 800 adult children (Gen X and Millennials) from families with at least $1 million in investable assets. Notably, the study finds meaningful disconnects between parents and their adult children when it comes to inheritance, family communication, estate planning, and financial preparedness. articles.summary: Customers can now upload personal photos to customize debit cards directly within the Wells Fargo Mobile® app. Wells Fargo today announced an enhanced digital banking experience with Mobile Card Design Studio ® 1 , giving customers the ability to personalize eligible debit cards directly within the Wells Fargo Mobile® 2 app. Customers can now upload personal photos to customize debit cards directly within the Wells Fargo Mobile® app. The enhancement brings Wells Fargo's distinctive, custom design feature into the palm of customers' hands, making it faster, easier and more intuitive to create a debit card that reflects what matters most to them. Customers can upload a personal photo directly from the photo library on their phone — a family moment, a beloved pet, a favorite vacation spot, a favorite memory, creating a card design that's uniquely their own — or they can choose from a curated gallery of designs.
